name: seated-kettlebell-press
instructions:
1. Assume a seated position on a bench while grasping a kettlebell with a neutral grip in both hands.
2. Curl or clean both kettlebells into a front racked position.
3. Press the bells overhead until the shoulders reach full flexion and the elbows are locked out.
4. Slowly lower the kettlebells back to the starting position and repeat for the assigned number of repetitions.
